Title: Human Liver Microsomal Stability
Description: Indicates whether a compound is likely to be cleared rapidly by human liver microsomes, the fraction carrying cytochrome P450 activity and the usual first checkpoint for metabolic stability. Compounds falling below a 30-minute half-life are treated as unstable. The predictor comes from NCATS work on liver-mediated metabolism, where in-house half-life measurements were paired with matched molecular pair analysis to extract structural transformations that shift stability. Microsomal assays omit cytosolic and phase II routes entirely.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound is unstable in human liver microsomes, with instability set at a half-life under 30 minutes.
